title: Pixel Art, Sprite, Voxel, Animation, and Pixel Media Skill Catalog

modes.assist: tool produces measurements/artifacts; artistic judgment stays with the operator
modes.guide: structured production guidance via the guide command
modes.built-in: safety behavior built into every command (overwrite guard, dry-run)

skills.name: Pixel Art Brief Interpreter
skills.description: Turns an idea, reference, theme, genre, audience, platform, size, palette, and animation need into a precise production brief.

skills.name: Pixel Style Director
skills.description: Defines pixel density, silhouette language, cluster shapes, line treatment, texture, lighting, and visual consistency for a project.

skills.name: Reference Board Synthesizer
skills.description: Organizes supplied visual references into actionable notes without copying protected characters, logos, or distinctive compositions.

skills.name: Theme and Genre Ideator

skills.name: Visual Constraint Planner

skills.name: Asset Scope Estimator

skills.name: Pixel Art Art-Bible Author

skills.name: Originality and IP Safety Reviewer
skills.description: Checks concepts for excessive similarity and redirects designs toward original, licensable, and clearly differentiated results.

skills.name: Audience and Readability Planner

skills.name: Multi-Asset Consistency Supervisor

skills.name: Dithering Pattern Designer
